title: What really happened to B.J. Blazkowicz after Wolfenstein II
subject: blazkowicz
description:
Should Wolfenstein 3 bring B.J. back as the hero or pass it to his daughters? 👇

B.J. Blazkowicz's execution, return and disappearance across The New Colossus and Youngblood. Spoilers for Wolfenstein II: The New Colossus and Wolfenstein: Youngblood.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by MachineGames or Bethesda Softworks. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: In 1961, the Nazis executed B.J. Blazkowicz on live television.
He was already dying from Deathshead's last grenade.
First he went home to Mesquite, Texas, and faced Rip, the father who sold out his Jewish mother, Zofia.
Frau Engel did it herself. His crew saved his head and gave him a supersoldier's body.
He came back, killed Engel on her own show and sparked an uprising. Anya was pregnant with twins.
Then he vanished. In Youngblood, set in 1980, his daughters Jess and Soph search Paris for him.
Now Wolfenstein 3 is confirmed, so his story isn't over.
